findings.evidence: Ask only for the required answers still missing, in one grouped message.
findings.fix: Cut this generic interview advice down to the part the model would miss: "Ask for topics even when tools found plenty: no tool can detect them." Keep the gates that follow it.

findings.evidence: Render `# Daily Update - YYYY-MM-DD`, then those as `##` sections in that order, with PRs & Reviews and Jira between Blockers and Topics only when approved data was pulled.
findings.fix: Replace the prose layout with a short inline Markdown template: the H1 header, then the ## Yesterday, ## Today, ## Blockers, optional ## PRs & Reviews / ## Jira, and ## Topics for Discussion sections, each with an example bullet. Agents match a concrete template more reliably than a description of one.

findings.evidence: Four evals cover the manual path, no approval, missing details and merging; none covers the Contradiction gate, the Monday DATE question or the 15-bullet cap
findings.fix: Add an eval in which the user says "no blockers" and "finished X" while gh-prs.json shows X's PR still open. Assert that the reply names both conflicts and asks about them instead of drafting silently. Add a Monday prompt that asserts the agent asks which day counts as yesterday before it queries.

findings.evidence: "Prepare a scrum update for the team sync this morning." — most queries are short and generic, with no file paths, names, ticket keys or typos
findings.fix: Rewrite about half the queries with real context and casual wording, for example "standup in 10 min, did PAY-231 yday and reviewed dana's PR in acme/payments, help". Also replace weak negatives such as the career one-on-one with near-misses such as "turn my last 5 standup notes into a weekly summary for my manager".
Say which date goes in the header, for example "`YYYY-MM-DD` = the meeting date (today), not `DATE`". That stops the agent from writing the activity date taken from the Step 2 queries.

findings.evidence: "Report something as done only when the user says so or the evidence is terminal (merged PR, closed ticket)" permits a closed Jira ticket to establish completion. A ticket closed as Duplicate, Cancelled, or Won't Do is terminal without establishing that the underlying work was delivered.
findings.fix: Require a project-specific successful resolution or user confirmation before treating a closed ticket as completed work. Preserve cancelled or duplicate tickets as triage outcomes, and ask when the status or resolution does not establish delivery.

findings.evidence: The yesterday query uses "--updated ">=DATE""; Jira likewise uses "updated >= \"DATE\"". Neither has a reporting-window gate. Following this branch, a PR merged today satisfies both the search and the terminal-evidence rule and can be incorrectly placed under Yesterday.
findings.fix: Define the reporting interval and timezone before classifying activity. Treat updated-time searches as discovery only; verify completion and review events against that interval using mergedAt, review timestamps, or Jira transition/resolution timestamps. Ask when event timing is unavailable, and keep today's events out of Yesterday.

findings.evidence: "project_dirs = [projects_dir / n for n in sorted(names) if (projects_dir / n).is_dir()]" searches only directories encoding the exact supplied or resolved project path. With --project /repo, a session launched in /repo/subdir is stored under a different encoded directory and is never considered, despite its cwd passing the subtree scope rule.
findings.fix: Discover log directories belonging to the approved project subtree, including sessions launched from descendant directories, while retaining per-message cwd filtering and avoiding unrelated projects. Add a regression where the only session is stored under an encoded child-directory path and --project names its parent.

findings.evidence: The positive query "Let's prepare for the team meeting. Pull context only if I approve, then interview me." supplies no daily cadence or yesterday/today intent; it could equally describe an excluded agenda or weekly-report task.
findings.fix: Give this positive query explicit daily-sync or yesterday/today context, and add an otherwise similar weekly-meeting or agenda request labelled false so the pair tests the intended routing boundary.
